originalTitle: Wildfires scorch Washington state as thousands evacuated and emergency declared
summary: State officials said wildfires across more than 250,000 acres have led to widespread evacuations and power outages.
content:
Wildfires across more than 250,000 acres have forced evacuations and caused power outages in the Washington state's Spokane area, US officials said.

Washington State Governor Bob Ferguson declared a statewide emergency and burn ban on Saturday morning.

"Our state is facing a very serious situation with multiple fires, and our hearts go out to Washingtonians who are losing their homes", Ferguson said.

According to officials, no injuries or fatalities have been reported.

Spokane is the state's second most populous city.
chineseTitle: 华盛顿州野火烧焦，数千人撤离并宣布进入紧急状态
chineseSummary: 该州官员表示，超过 25 万英亩的野火已导致大范围疏散和停电。
chineseContent:
美国官员称，超过25万英亩的山火已迫使华盛顿州斯波坎地区疏散并造成停电。

华盛顿州州长鲍勃·弗格森于周六早上宣布全州进入紧急状态并禁止焚烧。

弗格森说：“我们州正面临多起火灾的非常严重的局势，我们的心与失去家园的华盛顿人同在。”

据官员称，目前还没有人员伤亡的报告。

斯波坎是该州人口第二多的城市。
